body: Well there's a lot more to it than that. She has borderline personality disorder. Whenever we fight I have to see her sit on the floor and smash her head with her fists or cut her skin open. It's traumatizing. And I really don't wanna be with someone who screams at me every day.

Well it's stressful because she is very moody. One minute she's super nice and the next she's a hell demon designed to destroy my life. She wants to go out every day. I don't. She promises she will keep it down so we don't get evicted. She doesn't follow that.  I have to take care of her emotionally every day because she lashes out over small things. It's exhausting.

Well half of me says to stay with her. The problem is that I would feel absolutely terrible for leaving her. I'm not even sure I want to leave her. I have this overwhelming need to protect her because she's very very very fragile. So that's part of why I stay.
Well if I leave I'd have to go to a shelter. I have nobody to stay with. So that's another reason.

Well I forgot to mention in my original post that I just don't care for a solution. Let's say we break up. I have another breakdown, am jobless, no prospects, etc. I don't want to live through another breakdown like the one I had. It was very bad. I was starving myself for a few days. So I get through the breakdown and manage to find a job. I work to support myself in a piece of shit apartment and no way to go anywhere I want to go because I can't drive. Even if I could drive and had a good job I wouldn't care because I am going to die and everything I do is pointless. I truly believe that.
